THE EVALUATOR'S ROAD: inf_eval.sno compiles each test line by CODE(line '; :(inf_back)') and enters it by the direct goto :<inf_code>; the generator's kind=stmt walk emits one to three statements separated by ; with labels inf_L1..inf_L3, gotos :S() :F() :() :<> among them and :S(inf_ok)F(inf_no) on the last, over assignment to capitals, match and replacement statements; the result line is OK|FAILED|ERROR n|CODE-ERROR n then the capitals; the Snocone judge takes the same road only if Snocone can spell a direct goto (hq_snocone's answer), else the SCRIPtix demo keeps kind=expr|match

column11: c_presets gains (DATA('inf_pt(inf_u,inf_v)')); c_value gains inf_u(inf_pt(value, value)), inf_v(...), DATATYPE(inf_pt(...)), .inf_u(...); under the CODE road inf_u(P) = value

util_program_enumerator.py takes --engine dotnet|jvm|scrip: the port runner (run_snobol4<engine>.sh, the shared calling shape) replaces scrip_run for a port, --modes applies to scrip alone, the POPULATION line names the engine, witnesses are written per engine

--leaf-kinds int,var,str,real: string ('a' '' '1') and real (1.5 0.) leaves beside the integers and x y z, canon() folding a string to S and a real to R, --count-only per kind; the oracle program's env may hold strings

no generator change: the EVERY walk of infinite_snobol4 through the driver pins, five configurations each a deterministic batch: kind=expr elimit=1 (142 tests) and elimit=2 (994); kind=match plimit=1 climit=1 (1,806) and plimit=2 climit=2 (2,666); preset=3 (the closed world's every is a second random walk, count 50); elimit 3 and plimit 3 are past 200,000 and stay out

--grammar arith|unary|match: unary adds item := * item | $ item | . item | ~ item | ? item | @ item; match adds match := term | term ? term; every shape to length 5 (measure the counts with --count-only before the first run)

--statements: every expression under the six statement forms (subject; subject = repl; subject ? pat; subject ? pat = repl; each with :S(ok)F(no) or :(ok)) with x y z as subjects, compiled through the CODE road of step 11

HARVEST.tsv beside the generator: one row per reduced witness (date, engine, scope, seed0, batch, line, class, origin, row); every origin is a ladder__rungNN_inf_* entry of corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.csv added by util_add_ladder_witness.py --lang snobol4 with its ref cut from sbl -bf, PARTITION.tsv rebuilt in the same landing; the step is GREEN while every ledger row is in the master
